claims.evidence: The witness report identifies it as a printer but does not confirm color capabilities or multi-function features like scanning.
Speed and performance metrics cannot be verified through static photos or remote inspection.

risks.risk: The device may have mechanical defects or paper feed issues.
risks.proof: A video clip of the device printing a multi-page document.

risks.risk: Toner or ink cartridges may be empty or missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Supplies Status' report page.

risks.risk: The print head or drum may be damaged, causing streaks or poor quality.
risks.proof: A clear photo of a freshly printed 'Print Quality Diagnostic' page.

risks.risk: The scanner bed may be cracked or the scanner motor failed.
risks.proof: A photo of the scanner bed under the lid and a scan sample.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the model number sticker (usually on the back or inside the toner door).
A photo of the 'Configuration Report' or 'Supplies Status' page.
A video of the printer powering on and completing a print cycle.
A photo of the scanner glass (if it is an MFP).
response.reason: The specific model number is unknown, and the range of value between different HP printer tiers is too wide to set even a worst-case price.
